Controlled normalized fixture values are scenario coordinates only; they are not Earth constants, universal thresholds, scoring weights, or generated-world frequency targets.
Earth observations and models establish conditional response mechanisms, not unique mappings from province labels or radial influence fields to landform class.
Fixture expectations freeze research distinctions for later review but cannot be executed as a classifier or resolver.
Grain anisotropy remains ambiguity-or-unresolved only because current radial process fields do not carry an oriented structural tensor, line, or surface.
Isostatic support depends on density structure, thermal state, crustal and lithospheric thickness, load wavelength, flexural rigidity, and mantle reference state.
L1B cannot infer geometry, coordinates, elevation, slope, relief, coastline, land, water, bathymetry, surface material, climate, or renderer state.
Magmatic construction, tectonic thickening, delamination, lower-crustal flow, inherited strength, and dynamic support can overlap and remain non-unique.
Mechanical resistance depends on temperature, pressure, composition, fluids, strain rate, grain size, damage, and inherited structure unavailable in full from present upstream records.
Spatial-expression candidates are categorical families only and cannot be interpreted as generated belts, basins, shoulders, swells, plateaus, or lineaments.
Suppression and unresolved states must remain explicit where permissions, source evidence, structural roles, competing mechanisms, or spatial coverage are insufficient.
